headline: Senior Full Stack AI Engineer | LLM Systems & AI Agents | React/Next.js, Python & Distributed Systems
title: Senior Full Stack AI Engineer
base_summary: Full Stack Engineer with 6 years of software engineering experience, including deep specialization in architecting end-to-end Generative AI products, LLM pipelines, and resilient distributed web applications. Expert in bridging modern frontend experiences (Next.js 14, React 19, TypeScript, Vercel AI SDK) with production-grade backend microservices (Python FastAPI, Java Spring Boot, Node.js) and AI infrastructure (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pinecone, pgvector, Redis Semantic Caching). Proven track record delivering low-latency AI workflows (p99 latency <200ms, sub-2s generation), slashing LLM API unit economics by 35%, and scaling systems serving 1M+ daily transactions. Targeted for high-scale, product-driven engineering organizations like Stripe, Booking.com, and Airbnb.

bullets: Architected and launched an end-to-end AI-driven evaluation engine for open-ended candidate assessments, automating 60% of manual grading while achieving >95% scoring alignment with human evaluation rubrics.

Engineered full-stack capabilities for the Smart Interview platform, integrating real-time video streaming with dynamic LLM interview question generation, maintaining sub-2-second question generation latency under concurrent enterprise loads.
Developed a full-stack candidate analytics platform using React, TypeScript, and Spring Boot, processing 100K+ assessment responses daily to deliver percentile distributions and competency heatmaps.

Collaborated with ML scientists to deploy transformer-based scoring models into production REST and gRPC microservices, maintaining a p99 response time under 200ms during peak concurrent enterprise evaluation sessions.
Implemented Apache Kafka event streams to asynchronously decouple candidate submissions, scoring inference, and enterprise ATS webhook notifications, preventing downstream backpressure.
Built core full-stack workflows for a no-code data engineering automation platform using Next.js 14 and Python FastAPI, reducing customer pipeline onboarding time by 40%.

Optimized a LLaMA 2 inference pipeline using dynamic request batching, prompt caching, and Redis semantic vector search, reducing median query latency by 35% and lowering third-party model inference costs by 30%.

Architected a resilient Server-Sent Events (SSE) token-streaming pipeline with React streaming UI components, delivering seamless, token-by-token generative feedback with zero client-side UI thread freezing.
Engineered drag-and-drop workflow canvases with real-time graph validation, enabling enterprise analysts to execute complex multi-step data pipelines against heterogeneous enterprise data lakes.

Engineered an enterprise distributed inventory tracking platform utilizing Hyperledger Fabric chaincode, Node.js middleware, and responsive React interfaces, improving tracking accuracy by 30% and cutting reconciliation time by 25%.
Built RESTful middleware connecting distributed ledger audit trails with legacy ERP systems, supporting over 500 active enterprise warehouse operators across continuous scanning workflows.
Optimized PostgreSQL database queries, implementing composite indexing, partition pruning, and connection pooling that accelerated high-throughput inventory reads by 45%.
Conducted application security audits adhering to OWASP standards, identifying and remediating 3 critical authentication and data integrity vulnerabilities prior to enterprise production sign-off.
Developed mission-critical RESTful microservices and admin user interfaces in Java, Spring Web MVC, and Node.js, supporting 1,000,000+ daily transactions at 99.9% uptime reliability.
Implemented an event-driven pub/sub messaging abstraction layer integrating Apache Kafka and RabbitMQ with automatic retry semantics and dead-letter queues across 8 distinct microservices.
Built an automated service health monitoring daemon and alerting system, reducing operational Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR) by 40%.
